Product Description

How to cantact the smart watch for Android / iOS phone?

Step1:Download the "Da Fit " APP(by scanning the QR code in the manual)Please make sure to turn on call/SMS permission and bluetooth

Step2:Enter app to connect bluetooth APP and find TS29/Q50 to pair of your phone (Please fully charged it when the first time to use).

Large 1.69'' Full Screen Watch

Torjalph Bluetooth touch screen smart watch can support most android and iOS phones,more than 200 watch faces to choose it gives you a great visual experience when exploring outdoors

IP68 waterproof smart watch and 7 days battery life

IP68 waterproof rating (life waterproof),You can wear it swimming ,and it can be worn for washing hands and running in rainy days,230 mAh large capacity battery fast magnetic charging 3hours

Call / Message Notification

You can choose hang up and allows you to view the information on the display and the name of the sender.and when you receive a notification, SMS, calls or messages from APP (Facebook, WhatsAPP, Messenger, Instagram, Gmail and etc.) from the smart watch phone.

Sleep Monitor / Blood Pressure & Blood Oxygen Monitor

Torjalph fitness smart watch for men and women can monitor your heart rate and measure Blood Pressure & Blood Oxygen of health all day automatically.You can read them real-time directly on the smart watch

Supports 12 Sports Modes Smart Watch

Torjalph Fitness Tracker Smart watch for Android iOS Phones, you can walking,running,bicycle,swimming,badminton,basketball,football,rope skipping to give you more detailed insights into your whole day

Bluetooth Smart Watch Men Women Specification:

Resolution: 240*280

Waterproof: IP68

Charging Time: 3H

Battery Capacity: 230mAh

Screen: 1.69 inch LCD Full Touch Screen

Life Time: 5-7 Days of Use, 14 Days of Standby

Watchband Material : Silicone Strap

Battery Type: Built-in Rechargeable Lithium Polymer Battery

Compatible System: for Android 5.0+, iOS 9.0+

Smart Watch Size: 255.9*45*10.5mm

Weight: 40g

Color:Black

Package include:

1 x Torjalph fitness I68 Waterproof Smart Watch

1 x User Manual

1 x Charging Cable

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers find the smartwatch easy to use once set up and appreciate its appearance, noting it looks like an Apple Watch.       The price of this type of watch for what you get is unbeatable. It doesn't feel cheap, and it's got tons of perks that it checks for. The app seems to be well designed, not chaotic.     • Jono
      1 out of 5 stars
      Inaccurate distance and pace reporting
      Reviewed in the United States on September 7, 2026
      Color: black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Not accurate enough for running. I did 2 runs with this watch, and both times, the watch was WAY off - adding 27% more distance than was actually run and randomly reporting on pace. For $17.99, I didn't expect much, but this is unusable.

      RUN 1

      Actual: 2 miles, pace 9:00 per mile

      Reported: 2.62 miles, pace 6:52 per mile

      RUN 2

      Actual: 3 miles, pace 8:25 per mile

      Run 2 reported: 3.75 miles, pace 10:53 per mile

      To test accuracy, I ran with this watch alongside my iPhone connected to a Garmin HRM 600 heart rate monitor. These are routes that I run weekly.

      For $17.99, it's an impressive piece of technology, but not really usable for anything. I did also test out the other features, such as blood pressure monitoring and all of the other health features, which could be as inaccurate as everything else. There's just no way to know. It was a fun experiment, and I was hopeful that it could be used as a fit gap until I replace my Apple Watch with a new one, but after two runs and a few days of use, it was obvious that this watch is not dependable and cannot be used for tracking fitness activities.
